literal_meaning: অলসতা বা গড়িমস করে থাকা (শাব্দিকভাবে অলস আচরণের অনুকরণমূলক শব্দ)
figurative_meaning_bn: দুষ্ট গরুমোষের মত সমর্থ হয়েও ভার বইতে অনিহা
figurative_meaning_en: Unwillingness to bear burdens despite being as strong as a naughty cow or buffalo (laziness despite capability)
similar_in_english: strong as an ox but won't lift a finger
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে গড়িমসি করে কাজ করতে চায় না, যদিও শক্তিশালী।
গড়িমসির কারণে তার সব পরিকল্পনা ব্যর্থ হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He is full of laziness and refuses to work, even though he is strong.
His idleness ruined all his plans despite his capabilities.
history: Originates from Bengali agrarian culture where strong cattle like cows and buffaloes are common but sometimes stubborn and idle.
note: The idiom reflects rural Bengali life and attitudes towards work.
